location: Frank W. Mayborn Civic & Convention Center, Main Hall, 3303 N. 3rd Street, Temple, TX 76501
description:
Open house, drop in any time 5-7pm CDT. One of two in-person meetings on
the same proposals; the other is in Belton on 6 Aug 2026.

Proposed I-35 improvements from south of Loop 121 in Belton to Loop
363/US 190/SH 36 in Temple ("Segment 1"), part of extending I-14 from its
current terminus in Belton to BU 190 in Rogers.

A pre-recorded video of the same presentation goes up on the project page
by 5pm on 5 Aug 2026. Written comments must be postmarked or received by
21 Aug 2026 to enter the official record.
